sections.overview: This South American cichlid is known from the lower Orinoco basin and neighboring rivers.
sections.identification: The documented species reaches about 14 cm standard length; detailed field marks are not summarized here.
sections.habitat: FishBase classifies it as a tropical freshwater, benthopelagic fish.
sections.diet: The accessible species summaries do not provide a verified species-specific diet description.
sections.behavior: The sources consulted do not provide species-specific behavioral details.
sections.reproduction: The sources consulted do not provide species-specific reproductive details.
sections.ecology: It shares the genus Satanoperca with S. pappaterra, but the published ranges place this species in the Orinoco and pappaterra mainly in the Guaporé and Paraguay systems; see the related profile.
sections.conservation: FishBase lists a global IUCN assessment of Least Concern, dated 2020.
